meta.name: visor_data_v1
meta.status: ILLUSTRATIVE, ANALYST-ESTIMATED, PENDING VALIDATION. Not ground truth.
meta.envelope: Every numeric estimate is {low, base, high, unit, source_type, confidence (H/M/L), as_of, [note], [sources]}. Ratings and the reach index use value/point form.
meta.what_is_sourced: Incentive structures (Karnataka, Maharashtra), Hyderabad rent level and market direction, Bengaluru and Whitefield rent references, Telangana and Tamil Nadu policy status, Karnataka/Maharashtra policy dates. All from secondary summaries, none from official gazettes.
meta.what_is_estimated: All salaries, notice periods, talent scores, hiring capacity, switch premium adjustments, flex pricing, Pune and Chennai rents, vacancy levels, fit-out, lead times, anchor headcounts and placements, execution-ease ratings, EOR/captive cost parameters.
known_conflicts: Telangana: GCC-specific policy described as existing (2025-2030) by a vendor guide but reported as still being drafted by 2026 press. Neither quantified.
Maharashtra payroll subsidy: 'above INR 1 lakh per month, capped INR 5 crore/yr' vs 'up to INR 50,000 per employee per month'. Modelled as the former.
Karnataka Beyond Bengaluru EPF reimbursement: per-month vs per-year basis unclear. Not quantified.
design_notes: Chennai is the approved stub but is in a different state from Karnataka's Beyond Bengaluru package, so that package has no eligible micro-market (KA-BB-* records exist to test zone exclusion).
Salary is City x Domain x Band; micro-markets carry real estate, reach, vacancy and anchors (spec 4.2).
Unquantified incentives are shown in the UI with expected value 0 and a note; they must not be silently dropped.
